subject: Quantify - post-call SLO map & next steps
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Quantify - post-call SLO map & next steps

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

1) Key SLOs you confirmed on the call
   - P95 latency target: 150ms for single-turn text generation (95th percentile)
   - Streaming: support for chunked streaming with finalization token within 300ms of completion
   - Concurrency: baseline 250 concurrent active users, spike to 500 sustained QPS during peak (5–10m bursts)
   - Throughput: average input length ~120 tokens / response ~60 tokens; estimating 80k tokens/min sustained during peak windows

2) Workload constraints and priorities
   - User experience must not degrade during peak bursts; prefer slightly higher cost vs visible latency regressions
   - Data residency: US-only for PII-sensitive routes (we noted your security team requirement)

3) Cost/perf levers we talked about (initial recommendations)
   - Continuous batching with adaptive windowing (reduce per-token cost while keeping 95p below 150ms)
   - KV/prefix caching for repeated prompts (saves ~20–40% tokens depending on user reuse)
   - Model variants: production default = opt-7B-int8 for most flows; fallback to opt-13B-fp16 for edge cases requiring quality; also evaluate a distilled 3B for low-latency fallbacks
   - Quantization profiles: int8 dynamic for steady throughput; eval int4 on small-batch routing for cost experiments (quality tradeoffs planned)
   - Smart routing: route by latency budget (0–80ms local fast path, 80–160ms balanced path, >160ms fallback)

4) Proposed next steps / asks (owner in parentheses)
   - Share SOC2 + questionnaire and any specific audit artifacts you need from us (you) — you mentioned ops would send a template (attached if you have it)
   - Schedule a 90-minute POC kickoff with your infra + our performance eng team to validate p95 under synthetic and replay traffic (owner: Sofia/Quantify ops) — suggest Tue/Thu next week
   - Provide a short sample traffic trace (10–20k requests or replay capture) and a representative prompt set (Quantify) so we can run caching/batching sims (owner: Quantify)
   - We will produce two cost/perf configurations: ‘latency-first’ and ‘cost-first’ with expected p95, tokens/sec, and $/1M tokens (owner: Ben) — deliver in 3 business days after sample trace

Attachments: leave placeholders for SOC2 questionnaire if you have one.

I'll drop a shared Drive folder and a mutual action plan after we confirm the kickoff slot. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Sofia

Thanks Sofia — this is great and matches our notes. A couple clarifications: 

- The 150ms p95 target is for the pricing preview flow (critical). For the background batch enrichment jobs we only need <1s latency so routing for those is lower priority.
- For streaming: we need partial tokens to appear within ~60ms of generation start for the live editor feature; finalization window 300ms is fine.
- We can provide a 24-hour trace dump and a 2k prompt sample set. We'll redact PII before sending.

I've attached our SOC2 questionnaire (ops asked to get it started). Also looping in our CTO, Daniel Park (daniel.park@quantify.io) for any infra-level questions.
